subject: KDTW family note options for the Vancouver rental: rates, payments, payback months, IRR

items.label: AFR short-term, annual compounding, October 2026
items.source: Rev. Rul. 2026-19 Table 1, short-term AFR row, annual column (irs.gov/pub/irs-drop/rr-26-19.pdf)
items.note: Read Rev. Rul. 2026-19 PDF from irs.gov 21 Oct 2026, Table 1 short-term AFR annual. Monthly-compounding column is 4.17%.

items.label: AFR mid-term, annual compounding, October 2026
items.source: Rev. Rul. 2026-19 Table 1, mid-term AFR row (not 110% or 120%), annual column
items.note: Rev. Rul. 2026-19 Table 1 mid-term AFR annual, irs.gov 21 Oct 2026. For a monthly-pay note the monthly column (4.52%) is the like-for-like; AFR is fixed in the month the loan is made, not October.

items.label: Gross booking revenue per month, 60% occupancy at $250
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; steady state (month 5 onward, 100% of target occupancy), revenue basis cash, lodging tax pass-through (net zero); nights = (365/12) x occupancy, gross = nights x nightly rate

items.label: Net operating cash per month, 50% occupancy at $200
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; steady state (month 5 onward, 100% of target occupancy), revenue basis cash, lodging tax pass-through (net zero); net operating cash per M15, before any note payment, management $0
items.note: gross 3,041.67 less 11.75% platform, 1.5% B&O, 5% reserve, (nights/3) x 125 cleaning, 5/night supplies, 650 fixed. Excludes mortgage, property tax, HOA, income tax (M13): not free cash to Kev.

items.label: Net operating cash per month, 60% occupancy at $250
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; steady state (month 5 onward, 100% of target occupancy), revenue basis cash, lodging tax pass-through (net zero); net operating cash per M15, before any note payment, management $0

items.label: Net operating cash per month, 70% occupancy at $300
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; steady state (month 5 onward, 100% of target occupancy), revenue basis cash, lodging tax pass-through (net zero); net operating cash per M15, before any note payment, management $0
items.note: Same M15 build; above every public comp, best case only

items.label: Net operating cash per month, 50% at $200, with management 15% of gross
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; steady state (month 5 onward, 100% of target occupancy), revenue basis cash, lodging tax pass-through (net zero); net operating cash per M15 less management at 15% of gross (M12 sensitivity)
items.note: 1,126.84 less 456.25. Keys' co-host quote is 15% of room revenue after fees with a 300 floor: 15% of gross is conservative; the 300 floor would bind for six months

items.label: Option A monthly payment, $25,000, 48 months
items.source: Option A proposed terms: 7% a year fixed, interest monthly at one twelfth of the annual rate, 48 equal level payments, first at the end of month 1

items.label: Option A monthly payment, $50,000, 48 months
items.source: Same definition as the $25,000 note: 7% fixed, monthly, 48 equal level payments

items.label: Option A monthly payment, $50,000, 60 months
items.source: Same definition at 60 level monthly payments (Recommendation paragraph and the Option A 60-month sentence)

items.label: Option A total interest over the term, $25,000, 48 months
items.source: Option A proposed terms: sum of the 48 level payments less principal, payment not rounded before summing

items.label: Option A cash left to Kev per month, $50,000, 48 months, 50% occupancy at $200, steady state
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; steady state (month 5 onward, 100% of target occupancy), revenue basis cash, lodging tax pass-through (net zero); net operating cash less the Option A payment (negative if short)

items.label: Option A Kev cumulative cash after note payments, months 1 to 12, $50,000, 50% at $200
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; timeline M14 (setup months 1 and 2 earn nothing, months 3 and 4 at 50% and 75% of target occupancy, fixed costs from month 3); sum over months 1 to 12 of net operating cash less the note payment, which is paid every month from month 1
items.note: M14 ramp: m1-2 zero ops, m3 50%, m4 75% of target, fixed costs from m3; 12 payments of 1,197.31

items.label: Option B monthly share paid, $25,000, 60% at $250, steady state
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; steady state (month 5 onward, 100% of target occupancy), revenue basis cash, lodging tax pass-through (net zero); 16% of gross booking revenue

items.label: Option B months to repay 1.4x, $25,000, 16% of gross, 60% at $250
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; timeline M14 including ramp; monthly payment = 16% of that month's gross, capped at the remaining amount to 1.4x principal; months counted from funding at month 0 to the month the cap is reached
items.note: Simulated with M14 ramp, last payment trimmed to cap

items.label: Option B months to repay 1.3x, $25,000, 16% of gross, 50% at $200
items.source: Same rule, cap 1.3x principal

items.label: Option B months to repay 1.5x, $25,000, 16% of gross, 70% at $300
items.source: Same rule, cap 1.5x principal

items.label: Option B implied IRR at 1.4x, $25,000, 16% of gross, 60% at $250
items.source: Same rule; cash flows: minus principal at month 0, the monthly payments at month ends, final payment trimmed to the cap; monthly internal rate converted to effective annual as (1 + monthly rate)^12 - 1; stated in percent
items.note: Monthly IRR by bisection on simulated flows, (1+r)^12-1 = 16.82%

items.label: Option B net-share months to repay 1.4x, $25,000, 33% of net operating cash, 50% at $200
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; timeline M14 including ramp; payment = 33% of that month's net operating cash (zero if the month is negative), capped at the remaining amount to 1.4x principal
items.note: Simulated; month 3 net is negative (fixed costs on half occupancy), floored at zero

items.label: Co-host case: Option A cash left to Kev per month, $25,000, 48 months, 50% at $200
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; steady state (month 5 onward), net operating cash per M15 less management at 15% of gross, less the Option A monthly payment

items.label: Co-host case: Option B cash left to Kev per month, $50,000 at 32% of gross, 50% at $200
items.source: Model rules M1 to M15 and the Option A and Option B 'Proposed terms' in projects/600-se-101st-str/uncle-mike-options.md; steady state (month 5 onward), net operating cash per M15 less management at 15% of gross, less 32% of that month's gross booking revenue
